column1: # Shared binder rules (re/tools/bind/porttop_bind.py, BIND-PROFILE-DATA 2026-11-21). Every profile reads this file, then
# its own state/<profile>/rules.tsv. One rule per line, fields separated by TAB; a line starting with # is a comment.
# A binding row adds lines here or in its profile's rules.tsv, never code (KICKOFF_run54 rule 1). Kinds:
#   prov_bind  <rva>                       L-126 provisional body binds on the knob path (PROVISIONAL.tsv row needed)
#   extra_pre  <rva> <line>                line put before the source include of rva's wrapper (in file order)
#   extra_in   <rva> <line>                line put inside the include block of rva's wrapper (in file order)
#   alias      <rva> <symbol> <TU>         callers of rva bind this existing exe body (reuse)
#   local_shared   <caller> <callee> <symbol>   a file-local callee bound to the one exe copy named
#   local_as_bound <caller> <callee>            this source carries the only exe copy of callee (PortTop_Bound_<callee>)
#   lib_root   <lib> <root> <globs>        a vendored library: tree under the worktree root, source globs relative to it
#   lib        <rva> <lib> <symbol>        callers of rva bind the library's own symbol (BIND-LIB-ROUTE, 2026-11-21)
# L-126 provisional bodies bind on the knob path only for the rvas named here (kept narrow so the closure grows one
# reached stop at a time); c4=frida-replay rows (L-128) bind from their one re/match source with no line here.
